entries.title: Friendly number

entries.status_notes: Compound entry. Solitariness of 10 is open in Thackeray (2024); prime-factor lower bounds do not decide it.

entries.status_notes: Current status unverified: a 2024 claimed proof was withdrawn; a September 2026 OpenAI manuscript and Lean comparator claim a negative answer, not audited here.

existing_formalization.note: Comparator statement read; proof implementation not audited. The comparator contains a placeholder and is not itself an accepted proof.

entries.title: Gillies' conjecture
entries.exact_question: For prime exponents p, characterize the asymptotic distribution of prime factors of M_p=2^p-1 in intervals [A,B]; Gillies proposes a Poisson law with logarithmic mean.
entries.status_notes: Probabilistic formulation needs a sampling measure and joint limiting regime before formalization. The implied Mersenne-prime constant 2/log(2) conflicts with the LPW constant exp(gamma)/log(2).

primary_sources_checked.finding: Gillies proposes a Poisson factor-count heuristic. A precise probability space and coupled limit must be supplied before converting it into a formal target.
Wagstaff explains the LPW distribution heuristic and limitations of extrapolating Gillies factor statistics to primality. It is not a proof of infinitude.

existing_formalization.note: No claim of exhaustive search or nonexistence; formal statement is not a proof.

entries.plausible_full_solution_route: Derive arithmetic factorial moments for factor counts over prime exponents.
entries.obstruction: The article incorrectly calls M_p a Mersenne prime even when it is composite. Heuristic probabilities are not pointwise assertions about a fixed p.
entries.next_step: Read Gillies (1964) and Wagstaff (1983) with explicit averaging quantifiers.

entries.status_notes: Compound entry. Giuga numbers exist, but infinitude and the Giuga-Carmichael intersection are different open targets; Lava’s derivative equality is another stronger claim.

The October 2026 preprint develops idempotence and structural necessary conditions; it does not state a solution to the full infinitude or Giuga-Carmichael questions.

entries.obstruction: Squarefreeness and derivative reformulations do not force nonexistence or generate an unbounded family.
